findings.excerpt: 3M expects to incur $850 million in tariff-related expenses this year if it takes no mitigation actions, EVP and CFO Anurag Maheshwari said in an earnings call Tuesday. China-related tariffs, both from the U.S. and retaliatory measures, are expected to cost the company $675 million in 2025. The country accounts for 10% of 3M’s imports and just above 10% of exports,
